dataError.title: Something went wrong opening your journal
dataError.body: Orbit couldn't read what's on your device — this can happen if the app's storage gets out of sync. There's no way to repair it from here, only start fresh. Nothing was ever uploaded, so this is only ever lost locally.

appError.title: Something went wrong
appError.body: This screen hit a snag — your journal itself wasn't touched. Try again, or send the details if it keeps happening.

lock.hintWithBiometric: Face ID or enter your code

forgotConfirm.title: Erase your journal?
forgotConfirm.body: There's no account behind Orbit to verify it's really you, so the only honest recovery is starting over: this permanently deletes every person, date and note. This can't be undone.

passcodeSetup.createSub: You'll use this to unlock Orbit.

slide1.title: Dating is data you never write down.
slide1.body: Every date teaches you something — then it evaporates. Orbit catches it in two minutes while it is still fresh.

slide2.title: Answer a few honest questions.
slide2.body: Chemistry, conversation, comfort, mood. No essays. Tap through it on the walk home and you are done.

slide3.title: Patterns you cannot see from inside one date.
slide3.body: Levels and streaks for showing up. Then, once there is enough to read, reflections on what you keep choosing — and why.

goal.title: What are you after right now?
goal.sub: This shapes how your score is weighted. You can change it any time.

privacy.title: Lock it down?
privacy.sub: This is honest, private writing about real people. A passcode keeps it that way.

privacy.reassurance: Everything stays on your device. Nothing is uploaded, ever.
